need_help_description: Have a question or ran into an issue? Jump into our Discord and let us know, we’re happy to help.
clipboard_sync_description: Copy on one device, paste on another. Anything you copy is instantly available on your other devices.
clipboard_files_description: Include copied files. They download in the background so you can paste them straight into Finder or Explorer.
clipboard_max_size_description: Copies larger than this are not synced.
clipboard_max_size_warning: Large limits slow down every copy and use memory on the sending device. The share flow is a better fit for big files.
